Modules

BCM Platform Modules

Comprehensive Module Portfolio

Our platform consists of 28 specialized modules built on Odoo 18.0 Community Edition, each designed to address specific aspects of business continuity management while working seamlessly together.

Core Foundation Modules

BCM Base Module

Foundation for AI-Powered BCM

The base module provides essential infrastructure for all BCM operations, including AI service integration, event bus communication, and centralized logging. It serves as the foundation upon which all other modules build their functionality.

Key Capabilities:

  • AI Orchestrator integration framework
  • Document Processor API endpoints
  • Compliance Checker integration
  • EventBus real-time communication
  • Centralized audit logging
  • Multi-tenant data isolation

Technical Specifications:

  • REST API with OpenAPI 3.0 documentation
  • WebSocket support for real-time updates
  • Async task processing with Celery
  • Redis-based caching layer

BCM Core Module

Enterprise BCM Platform Foundation

Establishes the fundamental BCM framework with organizational structure, user management, and core business continuity processes.

Key Features:

  • Multi-organization support
  • Hierarchical business unit management
  • Role-based access control (RBAC)
  • Workflow engine integration
  • Document management system
  • Notification framework

Integration Points:

  • LDAP/Active Directory synchronization
  • SSO with OAuth 2.0/SAML
  • External HR system connectors
  • Email and SMS gateways

BCM Risk Management

AI-Enhanced Risk Assessment

Advanced risk management with predictive analytics, implementing FAIR methodology enhanced with Monte Carlo simulations and machine learning predictions.

Core Functionality:

  • Risk identification and categorization
  • Likelihood and impact assessment
  • AI-powered risk scoring
  • Risk treatment planning
  • Residual risk calculation
  • Risk appetite configuration

Advanced Features:

  • Predictive risk modeling
  • Scenario-based simulations
  • Heat map visualization
  • Automated risk alerts
  • Risk interconnection mapping
  • Historical trend analysis

AI Capabilities:

  • Pattern recognition for emerging risks
  • Anomaly detection in risk indicators
  • Natural language processing for risk descriptions
  • Automated risk mitigation recommendations
